name: evaluator-bug-childid-model
description: Reproduction of bug where condition childId="model" fails to evaluate correctly. When it evaluates correctly, Stone Trolls get the BP Infantry 10+ category, satisfying the Border Patrols constraint, and avoiding an unsupported modifier error.

rosters.description: Roster with Border Patrols rules and a 10-model Stone Trolls unit. If condition childId="model" works, it gains BP Infantry 10+ (6ad6-f54e-1867-00a7) and the unsupported modifier diagnostic is absent.
